title: prunella laciniata
intro: Prunella laciniata, commonly known as selfheal or heal-all, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and aiding in wound healing. Selfheal's therapeutic actions include being an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which contributes to its ability to calm irritated skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of Prunella laciniata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and make it a valuable herb in traditional medicine.
